# Typortrait

> Typortrait turns a photo and the words that matter into a portrait made entirely of words — a deeply personal keepsake or gift. Build and preview for free; download a high-resolution image for $14.99, or order framed prints, canvas, posters and tees shipped worldwide.

## What it is
- A web app at https://app.typortrait.com that composes a likeness of a person out of text: their name, the traits you love, a date, or a whole message.
- Two styles: Words (scattered traits) and Message (a passage laid out as readable lines that form the face).
- Colors include navy, sepia, burgundy, forest, gold-on-black and full photo color, on a light or dark background.
- No design skills, no Photoshop and no software install required — the app does the art automatically in seconds.

## How it works
1. Upload a clear, well-lit, front-facing head-and-shoulders photo of one person.
2. Type the words that matter, or paste a message.
3. Choose a style and color.
4. Pay once and download the full-resolution, watermark-free image — or order a print.

## Pricing
- Free to build and preview (no credit card required).
- $14.99 for a high-resolution, watermark-free digital download.
- Physical prints from $15: framed prints, gallery canvas, posters and tees, shipped worldwide. Choose a product right after creating your portrait.
- Secure checkout, powered by Stripe.

## Popular uses
- Memorials, anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, graduations, new babies, Mother's Day and Father's Day, children and pet portraits.

## Privacy
- Your photo is used only to create your portrait.
